item.title: 0.5.0-beta.8
item.description:
# Tiro public beta 8
This beta makes the Wireframe Board faster to open, draw on, and reuse.
- Open the board from anywhere with the customizable Control + Option + W shortcut. - Insert your latest Tiro screenshot, draw with four adaptive ink colors, and cancel unfinished work with Escape. - Save a wireframe and open that exact version in Preview, with clearer tools and cursor guidance throughout.
